title: Manual Closure of HV-312 — Rail Spot 2

lines.text: The ERT closed hand valve HV-312 at Rail Spot 2 at 11:48 and the vapor has stopped rising. WT-302 is steady at 38.1 tons. The ERT is coming out for decontamination.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged female, calm but firm, with measured urgency

instructorNote: This confirms the manual closure order was executed and the release is under control. Watch for any attempt to reassert control via the DCS or SIS.
